pages.text: Whenever the farm gate opened, it creaked. The sheep flinched at the sound.
"I want the gate to open quietly." Pipo gently moved it back and forth.
Mr. Horse stopped as he passed. "Who has time to fix that? Just push through hard!"
He shoved the gate with his shoulder. Thump! Creeeeak! Even louder.
Crack—the whole gate came off. Mr. Horse fell on his bottom, hugging it.
He stood awkwardly with the gate in his arms, not knowing where to put it.
While Pipo fetched an oil tin, Mr. Horse fitted the gate back in place. Pipo carefully oiled the hinges.
Pipo gave it a light push. Smoothly, the gate swung without a sound.
The gate opened and closed silently. The sheep grazed peacefully. Mr. Horse kept playing with it, opening and closing. "Hey, this is fun."
